title: phase 1 recon output (inputs.json)
description: The artifact `phase1_recon.md` Step 4 mandates. Regenerated from that contract after a real run found the two had drifted apart: this schema still described the deleted orchestrator's recon payload, requiring `subsystems` and `initial_tasks`, forbidding the four top-level keys the phase file requires (`run_id`, `target`, `frameworks`, `history`) under `additionalProperties: false`, and keying `inputs[]` on `id` where every consumer reads `input_id` (`coverage._input_id` prefers it; `specialists._has_authz_surface` reads `architecture.*`). The phase 1 agent could not validate its own output and had to choose which of two contradictory contracts was real. A schema nothing is ever validated against does not document a contract, it competes with one — so `tests/test_h2_run_defects.py` now round-trips a real artifact through this file.

oneOf.title: legacy orchestrator recon payload
oneOf.description: The shape the deleted CLI orchestrator emitted. Still exercised by tests/test_schemas.py and tests/test_design_controls.py, so it is kept as an explicit variant rather than quietly broken. Identified by carrying `subsystems`.

oneOf.title: phase 1 recon artifact (inputs.json)
oneOf.description: What phase1_recon.md Step 4 actually mandates. Carries no `subsystems`, and task generation belongs to phase 1b, so `initial_tasks` is absent too.

target_scope.description: Subtree the operator scoped the run to, e.g. 'src/h2'. Written here by phase 0/1 and honoured by taint.py.

frameworks.description: Detected frameworks. Either bare names, or the graded records recon_enumerate.py emits ({framework, confidence, evidence}). Both spellings occur in real artifacts and both are accepted; requiring only the graded form is part of what made the previous revision unusable.

history.description: Security patches mined from the target's own git history. An empty array is a real result and must be reported as a coverage gap rather than as an absence of history — the miner is keyed to the injection sink tables and is blind to a target whose defect history is bounds and state machines.

design_controls.description: Defences recon observed, so a hunter can argue past them rather than rediscover them. Item shape is enforced: a control missing its kind, location or description cannot be checked by anyone downstream.

architecture.description: Entry points and trust boundaries. `specialists.py` gates its access-control and batch-ETL sweeps on this being populated, so an empty object silently disables them.

input_id.description: Stable id. Preferred by every consumer; `id` is accepted as a legacy alias.

subsystems.description: Optional. Required by the previous revision of this schema; no phase writes it.

initial_tasks.description: Optional. Task generation is phase 1b's job (`tasks.json`), not phase 1's.
